Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a policy to mitigate carbon dioxide emissions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mitigating carbon dioxide emissions resultingfrom fossilfueled electrical generation; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature toestablish the policy for mitigating carbon dioxide emissions resultingfrom the fossilfueled electrical generation facilities located inWashington state.
